source.title: Notch Is Required for Neural Progenitor Proliferation During Embryonic Eye Regrowth.

intervention.timing: added following eye ablation at st. 27
intervention.description: Embryos injected at the four-cell stage with GFP and dexamethasone-dependent NICD mRNA, eye ablated at st. 27, then cultured in 20 nM concanamycin A without dexamethasone.

readout.method: eye regrowth scoring by eye size and morphology relative to unoperated age-matched siblings (Regrowth Index categories full/partial/weak/none)

notes: normal = fully regrown eye; eye_defect = all non-full categories pooled (partial, weak, none; split not given in text). Paper: 22.6% fully regrown, RI = 131, n = 110; 22.6% of 110 = 24.9, rounded to 25. Embryos carried NICD mRNA but dexamethasone was not added. Exposure duration for concanamycin A not stated.

source.title: Notch Is Required for Neural Progenitor Proliferation During Embryonic Eye Regrowth.

intervention.timing: added following eye ablation at st. 27
intervention.description: Embryos injected at the four-cell stage with GFP and dexamethasone-dependent NICD mRNA (0.25 ng), eye ablated at st. 27, then cultured in 20 nM concanamycin A plus 10 uM dexamethasone.

readout.method: eye regrowth scoring by eye size and morphology relative to unoperated age-matched siblings (Regrowth Index categories full/partial/weak/none)

notes: normal = fully regrown eye; eye_defect = all non-full categories pooled (partial, weak, none; split not given in text). Paper: 75.5% fully regrown, RI = 260, n = 106, p < 0.01 vs concanamycin-only; 75.5% of 106 = 80.0. Dose refers to concanamycin A. Exposure duration for concanamycin A not stated.
